title: Nine Pounds and One Handle
subtitle: 袋与包 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 袋与包（生活与自我·日常器物）
meta: 主题语境：袋与包（生活与自我·日常器物）　|　核心词汇：bag　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bag 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my grandmother carried ① a bag with nine things in it and could name none of them, and she said that was the test. The ② bag, meaning the object and not what was in it, had one handle and eleven years of wear; a bag, my mother said, is the only thing a person owns that is judged by how much it holds. She said the judging starts at the door.

Every ③ bag in that house had a purpose and had lost it, and she said that was the history of bags. Their ④ bag with the broken handle carried nine pounds of potatoes and one letter; a bag, my father said, is the only container that is trusted with things it cannot hold. He said the trusting is the whole of shopping.

My grandfather used the word differently and meant ⑤ a bag of flour, meaning the measure and not the cloth. The ⑥ bag, meaning the amount and not the object, is the only unit of measurement that depends on how strong you are; a bag, he said, is either a thing you carry or a quantity you cook with. She said the cooking settles the argument.

By 1974 the ⑦ bag had become the reason she did not go out, and my mother said that was the true history of it. The ⑧ bag under her eye was nine years old and had arrived with a letter in 1965; a bag, my father said, is either something you carry or something you carry on your face, and the second cannot be put down. He said the first can.

The ⑨ bag I remember is the one with the broken handle, which she took to the shop for eleven years. A ⑩ bag, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only possession that is fuller at the end of the day than at the beginning; every bag, she said, is a promise to carry things you will not need. She said the promise is never broken.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 袋；包（一个具体的袋）
B. n. 袋（指这个物件，与里面的东西相对）
C. n. 袋（指断了提手、装九磅土豆那一只）
D. 固定搭配：carry a bag 提着一只袋
E. 固定搭配：a bag of flour 一袋面粉
F. n. 一袋之量（作为计量单位）
H. n. 袋（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: a bag with nine things in it
The bag, meaning the object and not what was in it
Their bag with the broken handle
The bag, meaning the amount and not the object
the bag had become the reason she did not go out
A bag, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: carry a bag 意为“提着一只袋”，1966 年祖母提着一只装着九样东西的袋，却一样也叫不出名字，她说这就是检验。
bag 指“这个物件”，与里面的东西相对，它只有一根提手，却磨了十一年。
bag 意为“袋、包”，那屋里每一只袋都曾有过用途，后来又都失去了用途，她说这就是袋的历史。
bag 指断了提手、装九磅土豆那一只，那只断了提手的袋装过九磅土豆和一封信。
a bag of flour 意为“一袋面粉”，祖父指的是量而不是那块布。
bag 意为“一袋之量（计量单位）”，与物件相对，它是唯一取决于你有多强壮的计量单位。
bag 意为“袋”，到 1974 年这只袋成了她不出门的理由，母亲说这才是它真正的历史。
bag 意为“眼袋”，她眼睛下面那个眼袋有九年了，是 1965 年随一封信一起出现的。
bag 意为“袋”，我记得的是断了提手那一只，她拎着它上店买了十一年东西。
bag 为抽象总称，泛指“袋这种东西”，祖母说袋是唯一在一天结束时比开始时更满的财物。
